County of Albany ) 
We , the undersigned, Electors of the County above named were this day taken 
to the assistance of the County Clerk of said County, and foregoing canvass made in 
our presence, at the County Clerk's Office at Laramie in said County, this 22nd day 
of August 2024. 
State of Wyoming ) 
) ss 
County of Albany ) 
d Member (R) 
~ut, Can vass Board Member (D) 
I, Kayla White, County Clerk within and for the County and State aforesaid, do 
certify that the forgoing abstract of the votes is a full, true and correct copy of the 
canvass of returns of all votes cast in the county for the candidates set forth at a 
Primary Election held in the Election Districts in the County of Albany, in said 
• State on Tuesday, the 20th day of August, 2024, and I hereby certify the returns 
from these precincts in said county have been received and have been counted and 
are embodied in such abstract. 
IN TESTIMONY WHEREOF, I hereunto set my hand and affix the seal of 
said County at my office in Laramie, in said County, the 22nd day of August, A.D. 
2024.
